decision: This campaign explicitly requires preservation and publication of successful and unsuccessful exact experiments. The two completed 300-candidate cohorts contain complete changed-circuit descriptors, exact coefficient/frame/rank certificates, scientific measurements, terminal checkpoints and their logs. Their 5.424 GB original UTF-8 evidence is retained unchanged outside Git; complete gzip copies measure about 337 MB. Preserve the entire reproducible record in one scoped bulk evidence import rather than omit row-level certificates or split any source payload to meet the ordinary aggregate guard. This documented one-time research publication decision applies only to the two named completed evidence namespaces. Readable authored code, configurations and reports keep the ordinary20 MiB aggregate limit; every gzip stays strictly below10 MiB. No downloaded sources, environments, weights, binaries, active outputs or private configuration are included.
